title: Daily Devotional #35
paragraphs: Today, as I read through Mark 7, I am struck by Jesus' words that it is not what goes into a person that defiles them, but what comes out of their heart. As I reflect on this, I realize how often I focus on outward appearances and actions, rather than the state of my heart.

It's easy to fall into the trap of thinking that if I just do all the right things, then I am good enough. But Jesus reminds me that true worship and righteousness come from a pure heart, not just external actions.

As I examine my heart today, I realize that there are areas where I need to confess and seek forgiveness. I have been quick to judge others, thinking that my outward actions make me better than them. But Jesus calls me to examine the condition of my heart and to seek to remove any impurities within.
I am grateful that Jesus offers us a way to purify our hearts through his sacrifice on the cross. As I turn to him in repentance, I know that he will cleanse me and transform me from the inside out.

Lord, today I ask for your forgiveness for any impurities in my heart. I pray that you would help me to focus not just on external actions, but on the state of my heart. Help me to worship you in spirit and in truth, with a pure heart that reflects your love and grace. Amen.
